FIELDS.NAME: Bistro 79
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Bistro 79 operates as a full-service family restaurant, offering a menu that includes a variety of freshly prepared dishes, emphasizing quality ingredients and exceptional service. Our establishment focuses on providing a welcoming atmosphere for families, where guests can enjoy meals together. To maintain a responsible liquor service, we limit our alcohol offerings to beer and wine, ensuring that these sales do not exceed 30% of total revenue. We have a seating capacity of 150 customers, allowing us to manage crowd-related safety effectively. Our kitchen is equipped with required fire suppression and ventilation systems, ensuring compliance with safety codes. Operating year-round, we pride ourselves on maintaining consistent quality of service and food safety, while minimizing off-premises food sales to less than 10% of total sales. We believe that these practices help us provide a safe dining experience while mitigating risks associated with our operations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that it limits alcohol sales to beer and wine only, with no liquor or spirits permitted. Additionally, alcohol sales in our quick-service restaurant do not exceed 25% of total sales, and in our full-service family restaurant, they remain below 30% of total revenue. Furthermore, there is no bar or cocktail lounge within our quick-service restaurant, ensuring full compliance with the specified conditions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 10, 2021, a fire caused by a malfunctioning kitchen appliance resulted in $10,000 in damages to the property and equipment, which has been fully repaired. The claim was settled, and the incident is currently marked as resolved. Additionally, on February 15, 2023, a slip and fall accident led to a $5,000 settlement for medical expenses. This claim has also been resolved, with measures put in place to enhance safety protocols in the restaurant.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1: Commercial Safe with UL rating, secure location with limited access, monitored alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour surveillance system with motion detectors and security patrols.
